scope: Business-risk sectors only. Tags are info context: never a risk signal on their own (score effect 0); correlation rules may combine them with other signals.

payments_crypto.label: payment and crypto-asset activities (exchange, cards, payment and crypto services)

excluded.6311900: data processing/hosting: crypto-asset mining is one listed activity among many (would tag ordinary IT companies)
excluded.7740300: intangible-asset management (royalties, franchising): crypto-asset lending is one listed activity among many
excluded.8299702: meal/transport voucher issuers: payment instruments outside the financial divisions; left out pending a sector review
excluded.8299706: lottery outlets (CAIXA banking correspondents), not betting operators

lgpd_note: Division 94 (associations: unions 9420-1/00, religious 9491-0/00, political 9492-8/00 and the rest) reveals union, religious or political affiliation (LGPD art. 5 II and 11): it never gets a sector tag, is never a risk signal and is never propagated as an attribute to natural persons (P235 cond 5).
